name: Fishing
text: Someone noticed fish crowding the shallows. Woven traps can pull food out of the river.

name: Stone tools
text: Chipped stone edges cut wood and bone, and digging sticks improve gathering. Woodcutters can bring in wood faster.

name: Cooking
text: Someone dropped meat into the embers and ate it. Cooked food feeds more, and meals around the fire become lessons: knowledge now spreads faster.

name: Spears
text: Stone points lashed to long shafts. Hunters can bring down game, and the best season for it is autumn.

name: Hide and pole work
text: Your people learn to lash poles and stretch hides. Shelters and drying racks can now be built.

name: Herbal lore
text: The women who deliver babies share which herbs ease fever and pain. A healer's hut can keep people alive.

name: Oral tradition
text: Stories, songs and names: what one person learns, the whole band can keep. Knowledge spreads faster, and a story circle holds people together.

name: Dugout canoes
text: Hollowed logs float. Fishers can reach deeper water and bigger runs.

name: Pottery
text: Fired clay holds water and keeps food dry. Less of your stores spoil, and storage pits are possible.

name: Warm clothing
text: Sewn hides and fur keep people alive through the cold. Winters will be kinder.
